headline: Blackwing Lair in 33:00, the guild's fastest clear, eight bosses and no wipes

mvp.headline: most healing on three bosses and 11 Chromaggus afflictions cleansed
why: First of the healers on Razorgore, Vaelastrasz (33k in 30 seconds) and Firemaw, second on Broodlord, third on Ebonroc, Flamegor and Nefarian
11 Brood Afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus, tied for the most with Norgewian

also.text: most damage on Firemaw, Ebonroc and Nefarian (148k), second on Chromaggus and Flamegor
most damage on Vaelastrasz (70k) and Chromaggus (123k)
6 Tranquilizing Shots across Flamegor and Chromaggus, with Zbleh taking the rest

overview: 8 of 8 in 33:00, 23 seconds under the guild's previous best Blackwing Lair (33:23) and 14 minutes under the usual night (47:34). Ebonroc (0:45) equalled the guild record and Firemaw (0:44) was a second off it. One boss death all night.
Fast everywhere: Nefarian in 1:34 against a usual 2:27, Chromaggus 1:21 against 1:57, Firemaw 0:44 against 1:41. The median parse on Nefarian was 88, where the guild usually sits around 65.

World buffs: Razorgore and Vaelastrasz had them on only 15 of 40, then 37 had Rallying Cry and Zandalar from Broodlord on, the usual sign of buffs stored in a Chronoboon for the first two. Warchief's Blessing was on 8 to 10 raiders all night.

Skoomael came on the character the logs know him by and was top three on parses on Vaelastrasz, Broodlord, Firemaw and Flamegor, and battle-rezzed Hulldor after Lord Victor Nefarius killed him before the fight. Recorded here because it might not happen again.

wentWell.text: Nefarian in 1:34 (median 2:27) with no deaths. 0.25 fears per raider against a usual 1.3, 9 Fear Wards, and only 3 class calls landed on anyone.
Firemaw in 0:44, a second off the guild record (median 1:41). Flame Buffet stacks at 6.6 per raider, half the usual 13.6.
Ebonroc in 0:45, equal to the guild record.
Chromaggus in 1:21 (median 1:57) with no deaths. 51 afflictions cleansed: Künigünde and Norgewian 11 each, Elozia 10.

notes.text: 0:30 (median 0:46), no deaths, 33k raid DPS against a usual 22k. Tochopolvo 70k.
Cleave did 38k, 17% of the damage taken, against about 2.5% on a usual kill.
Hjärterkung, tanking, went from 87% to dead in under two seconds at 0:08, with a Mortal Strike among the hits. The only boss death of the night.
0:40 (median 0:50) regardless. Blast Wave hit 18 raiders, half the usual rate.

0:52 (median 1:05). Frenzy came up 5 times; Punintended and Zbleh tranquilized 4 of them.
